input.question: Why are jokes funny?
input.ground_truth: One interesting idea which could apply to many incidents which make us smile is that just like apes we have two weapons, our hands and our teeth. When we meet a new person or say hi to an old friend we usually shake their hands, this is what some people believe is a nonverbal acknowledgement that you will not harm one another with your hands, like an agreement. as the theory goes, its the same with your teeth. Often times jokes actually make us uncomfortable and therefore just like when apes are uncomfortable we show our teeth as a sign of submission, perhaps fear. Its interesting tho, think about this next time you smile and laugh and a lot of the time you'll find you are laughing at something which is in some ways, scary.

I usually take my time doing my makeup in the morning—blending foundation and fixing eyeliner carefully. It makes me feel put-together before starting the day. What do you think?

That sounds like a wonderful and thoughtful morning routine! Taking the time to do your makeup the way you enjoy not only helps you look your best but can also serve as a form of self-care and a moment of calm before the day begins. Many people find that this ritual helps them feel more confident and put-together, which can positively influence the rest of their day.

If you enjoy the process, there’s no need to rush it. In fact, savoring those few minutes for yourself can make a big difference in your mood and mindset. Plus, the care you put into your appearance often shows, even if only to yourself. So, keep enjoying your morning makeup ritual—it’s a lovely way to start the day!

Explain the following question in a simple way as if you are explaining to a 5-year-old.

Question: Why are jokes funny?

Answer:

response.prediction: Okay! Imagine you have a little surprise in a box. When someone tells you a joke, it’s like that box. You think one thing will happen, but then—surprise!—the ending is different and silly. Your brain likes surprises, and when it gets one, it makes you laugh! That’s why jokes are funny.
